comments.title: Why You Can't Stand On Jupiter
comments.question: Galileo never found a floor. How far down do you think Orbit would get before turning back?
How long do Saturn's rings have left?

comments.title: What Happened to Venus?
comments.question: Venus started like Earth: same size, same rock. It lost its water and kept its carbon dioxide in the air. Do you think Venus ever had oceans, or did the steam never come down? Tell me why.

comments.title: What Happens If You Travel Near Light Speed?
comments.question: Near light speed your own clock slows: one year on board, seven years at home. Would you take a trip that costs you seven years at home for one of yours? Tell me why.
